description: US federal job openings from the official USAJOBS Search API: title, agency, location, pay range, closing date, link. Needs a free USAJOBS key (set USAJOBS_API_KEY and USAJOBS_EMAIL); without them the tool answers 503. Related tools on this server, for a different need: jobs_arbeitnow when you need job openings from the Arbeitnow public job board API; jobs_jooble when you need job search on Jooble's aggregator through its official REST. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.
name: jobs_usajobs
